description: This file defines internal error handling, error classes, and error codes for Node.js core, including functions to create and manage various error types and error messages, as well as error code registration.

classes.name: SystemError
classes.description: A specialized Error class that includes additional info properties for system errors, such as code, errno, syscall, path, and dest.

methods.name: makeSystemErrorWithCode
methods.description: Creates a subclass of SystemError with a specific error code.

methods.name: makeNodeErrorWithCode
methods.description: Creates a subclass of a given Error base class with a specific error code.

methods.name: addCodeToName
methods.description: Adds error code to the error's name property and manages stack trace capture.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves and formats error messages based on error code and arguments.

methods.name: uvErrmapGet
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with a libuv error code.

methods.name: uvException
methods.description: Creates an Error object representing a UVException with context data.

methods.name: uvExceptionWithHostPort
methods.description: Creates an Error object for a UV error with host and port information.

methods.name: errnoException
methods.description: Creates an Error object for a system error based on errno.

methods.name: exceptionWithHostPort
methods.description: Creates an Error object for a libuv error with host and port info (deprecated).

methods.name: dnsException
methods.description: Creates an Error object for DNS-related errors.

methods.name: connResetException
methods.description: Creates an Error object representing a connection reset error.

methods.name: isStackOverflowError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a stack overflow error.

methods.name: addNumericalSeparator
methods.description: Formats large numbers with underscores for readability.
